sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000084-P1, was presented by MERCK & COMPANY (the Supplier) to Pioneer Family Clinic 084 on June 4, 2024.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 2 rebate of 4%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 120 Pneumococcal doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
